text:
I re-checked the earlier schedule against every constraint, and it holds. The team note's "Elif first, Cara second" option is impossible.

- Finn is right after Elif, and Gus is right after Finn, so Elif, Finn, Gus are consecutive.
- Ben must come before Finn. Since Finn is right after Elif, Ben is before Elif.
- Hana is right after Ben, and Hana can't be Elif, so Hana also comes before Elif.
- Cara is before Dev and Dev is before Ben, which gives Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana, then Elif, Finn, Gus.
- Ann must come after Elif. The block Elif, Finn, Gus has no gap, so Ann is after Gus. Ivo is right after Ann, which makes Ann 8 and Ivo 9.
- The order is forced, so the solution is unique.
- Hana is in slot 4 and Ivo in slot 9, five apart, which meets the "at least three" rule.
- If Elif were first, Finn would be in slot 2. Ben would then have to be in slot 1, which Elif already holds.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Cara","2":"Dev","3":"Ben","4":"Hana","5":"Elif","6":"Finn","7":"Gus","8":"Ann","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 99
